description: Read the structured data a page declares about itself: products, articles, events, organizations. The structured data a page declares about itself: every JSON-LD block parsed, the schema.org types found, and the Open Graph tags. Fetched through a residential IP with a real browser. No model in the path. Body: {url}. — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "get the json-ld of this page", "read the structured data a page declares", "extract schema.org from this URL".
name: web_jsonld
